Each floor has bathrooms, kitchens, and dining areas, and superior offices come with balconies, kitchens, bathrooms, and pantries.

The Light Commercial Tower is an exclusive mixed-use freehold commercial and retail tower located in one of Dubai's most exciting and emerging districts Arjan in the heart of New Dubai. One Direction Real Estate proudly presents this spacious open-plan office for sale in Dubai Star, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT).

This property offers a generous and highly flexible office layout, making it an excellent opportunity for businesses, entrepreneurs, and investors looking for a commercial property in one of Dubai’s established business communities. The office features an open-space configuration, providing the new owner with the freedom to design and customize the entire workspace according to their specific business requirements.

The open-plan layout allows for efficient utilization of the available space and provides numerous possibilities for office planning. The new owner can create a combination of individual workstations, private offices, executive cabins, meeting rooms, conference areas, reception space, waiting areas, and collaborative working zones depending on the nature and size of the business.

The office is offered unfurnished, giving the buyer complete flexibility to select furniture, office equipment, partitions, and interior finishes according to their preferred design and corporate identity. Whether the intention is to create a modern open workspace, a traditional office environment, or a combination of private and shared areas, the layout provides a suitable foundation for customization.

The spacious floor plan is particularly beneficial for companies that require room for expansion or prefer an office environment where different departments can operate within the same workspace.
